title: video.presence.aggregate
description: Unioned presence time for ONE scope over a reporting period, computed from ParticipantSpan rows. Pass exactly one of user_id / room_key; passing both (or neither) is an error, because the two answer different questions. The window is a UTC calendar month via `period` ("YYYY-MM", half-open [start, end)), or an explicit period_start/period_end ISO pair. Response: {"user_id": string|null, "room_key": string|null, "period_start": string, "period_end": string, "presence_seconds": integer, "rooms_count": integer, "users_count": integer, "spans_count": integer}. presence_seconds is a UNION, never a sum: one person on a laptop and a phone was present once, and billing a second device as a second human is not defensible. For a room scope it is person-seconds inside that room (each attendee's merged timeline), not the room's wall clock. Spans still open are counted up to now, clipped to the window. No threshold is applied anywhere — the consumer owns that policy.

user_id.description: Scope: one person, across every room and device.

room_key.description: Scope: one room, as the opaque key the spans were recorded under.

period.description: UTC calendar month, "YYYY-MM". Takes precedence over period_start/period_end.

period_start.description: ISO-8601 window start (inclusive), for a reporting window that is not a calendar month.
